text:
maria: FYI hitting a serialization mismatch when hosted routes to a dedicated runtime that hasn't upgraded adapters. request had extra `attachments` array, runtime returned 422 and logs said: "unknown field: attachments"

sahil: seen this before with embedding metadata + new envelope shape. we tried letting runtimes be permissive but that hides real incompatibilities.

jordan: can you paste the exact envelope? is it the new `attachments` vs old `assets` rename?

maria: yep. hosted sends `attachments` (array of {type,url,meta}) but older adapters expect `assets`. simple rename breaks JSON-schema validation.

lena: two big paths here: 1) require adapters to advertise capability `envelope_v2` and fail probe if absent; 2) translate at the hosting layer and keep older adapters untouched; 3) do nothing and rely on runtime permissive parsing.

sahil: translate at hosting is quick win for hosted users but pushes complexity into control plane. also we have telemetry blind spots if translation masks failures.

maria: also important: some Dedicated customers manage their own runtimes and are slow to upgrade. we can't break them silently.

jordan: what about hybrid: add capability bit + soft-translate. handshake advertises capabilities; if `envelope_v2` missing, hosting will attempt translation but include header `X-Translated-Envelope: true` and emit metric `envelope_translated`. If translation fails, return 409 with clear `upgrade_required` body.

lena: love that. it gives us observability and a fail-safe. we should gate translation behind a tenant feature-flag so we can toggle per-tenant if it causes CPU/latency issues.

sahil: add to that: translation must be checksum-preserving for opaque blobs (auth tokens, signed manifests). never mutate or re-sign. if opaque field present, copy as-is; if schema rename affects opaque validation, fail translation.

maria: ops note: add canary in Dedicated pool for customers we manage; for private/on-prem, publish a small shim lib `env-normalizer` that swaps `attachments`<->`assets` and verify with our probe harness.

jordan: RFC sketch: - new probe field `ProbeResponse.capabilities` includes `envelope_v2` - hosting translation pipeline module with deterministic rules + unit tests - telemetry counters and tenant feature-flag - error code 409/UPGRADE_REQUIRED when translation impossible - migration doc for Dedicated/Private.

lena: also include SLO safe-guards: translation must run under X ms or be opt-out. add a rollback runbook if translation increases P50 by >20ms.

sahil: I'll draft RFC and include pseudocode for translation and sample manifest diff for probe. will add test in `probe-harness` that simulates `assets` only runtime.

maria: ping eng-arch after draft. also include a line for security review: make sure we don't accidentally expose internal headers during translation.

ops-bot: probe-harness job 4521 passed on staging at 2026-03-24T09:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

jordan: one more edge: what if future envelopes add mutually incompatible semantics (not just renames)? we should document a small set of stable wire fields and reserve others as opt-in via capabilities.

lena: agreed. RFC should propose "stable core" vs "extensible" envelope regions and a capability registry.

maria: great. thanks team — will create the migration tracking ticket and link it in the RFC.
